definitions.meaning: A water-stream, a river, the sea

quotations.english: the just Creator had averted the stream
the host encamped near the river
quotations.citations: Elen. Kmbl. 132; El. 66: Beo. Th. 1158; B. 577

source_text: ég-streám, éh-streám, es; m. A water-stream, a river, the sea; aquæ fluctus, fl&u-long;men, m&a-short;re :-- Hæfde Metod égstreám eft gecyrred the just Creator had averted the stream, Cd. 71; Th. 85, 15; Gen. 1415. Here wícode égstreáme neáh the host encamped near the river, Elen. Kmbl. 132; El. 66: Beo. Th. 1158; B. 577. v. eá-streám.
